translated_title: Tomorrow, July 1, Key Day to Determine the Validity and Review of the T-MEC: Sheinbaum
original_title: Mañana 1 de julio, día clave para determinar la vigencia y revisión del T-MEC: Sheinbaum
author: Alonso Urrutia and Arturo Sánchez
meta_description: Canada and Mexico have already signed to ratify; only Trump's position is pending, and the treaty's ten-year clause means a 'no' would not end it tomorrow.
